items: A new guided tutorial: a short story intro and 16 lessons, skippable and resumable from Settings
First-time tips for big systems like the Unseen, camps, the Hunt and the Hollow Isle (can be switched off)
Faster: new worlds start and saves load about a third quicker, and the Apocalypse runs smoother
Export and Paste import work inside the Android app
The Hollow Isle campaign no longer stalls when the high priest retakes the landing fort
The Unseen tabs fit on phones, and a clear message if your town fell before the voyage
Fixed: the new-world form showed your ruler's face twice
